# case: 26-env-reserved-file-only
# desc: a file-only-reserved key (LD_PRELOAD) from the project env file is rejected before any runtime argument is built; the same key via -e is fine
# config: docker-darwin

2

(empty)
--- stdout ---
(empty)
--- stderr ---
error: .claude-contained/env:1: LD_PRELOAD cannot be set from a project env file
       It is read by the sandbox wrapper itself; pass -e LD_PRELOAD=... if you mean it.

  | LD_PRELOAD=/tmp/evil.so
